text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I have ended up confiding
so many of my secrets to you, haven't I?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Today marks the end of that. From here on, I shall take you
to the place where I harbor my most shameful feelings.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I want you to know... everything about me.

On the way back from our outing, Mejiro McQueen
led me to a certain place. It was—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
T-The bathhouse!? No, no, you misunderstand.
When I said shameful, I didn't mean it in that sense...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Please don't get any strange ideas.
My most shameful part is—
(*RIIIIING*!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: "Yes. This is the shameful place where I cannot help but harbor unseemly desires."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
A place where you end up wishing for dreams
you aren't supposed to wish for...
choice_data_list: What do you mean, a dream you're not allowed to wish for?
What is a dream you're not supposed to wish for?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Whenever I face an unbearable setback...
I come here and find myself thinking,
'I just want to go far away...'

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I am a daughter of the Mejiro family. I always keep in mind that I must remain strong.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"Even so, sometimes I yearn for it.
To live an innocent, carefree life beyond this sky."
choice_data_list: It's not really something to be ashamed of...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"—No, this is precisely what is
most shameful."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
To be born a Mejiro,
yet try to forget the Mejiro name...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
The most sinful betrayal against my dear grandmother,
who loves me so. And yet...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, that is who I truly am as well.
Being elegant is just a facade. Just me putting on a brave face.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: In truth, I am merely a pathetic, weak girl.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I might not be someone who can live up to your expectations.
Not someone worthy of them...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"Even so... are you sure you're all right with this?
Pouring so much care into raising me, and all."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Will you... not regret this? Truly?
choice_data_list: Yeah, there's no way I'll regret it.
Yes, I won't have any regrets.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Trainer...
What unwavering eyes you have...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
That is true.
It is precisely because you are like that... that I...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Fufu, I am so glad I brought you here.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Thanks to that, it's gotten so much easier!

Mejiro McQueen is smiling happily.
It seems she's been freed from the heavy burden she was carrying.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Fufu...
Still, racing abroad is quite charming as well, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
There are things I can't learn here,
so in a positive sense, I would like to go.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Huh? With me!?
Wh-Why would you bring something like that up so suddenly?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Still... I suppose so. That is fine by me.
We are no longer strangers, after all...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: With me... which country do you wish to go to?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
France... I see,
I understand your intention.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"I would love to go as Japan's representative Umamusume one day.
To prepare for that day, I must train even harder!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
New Caledonia... I feel like I've
heard of it before. So such a country exists.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to that, I feel a little more knowledgeable.
What kind of place is it?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: T-The Mejiro Kingdom...? What kind of daydream are you having? There is no such country...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Fufu, but it would certainly be amusing if it truly existed.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
If such a country truly existed,
I wouldn't be McQueenâI would be Queen.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
...!! I see. I understand now.
Your dream is to build a Millennial Kingdom with me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: How wonderful. I shall win the Tenno Sho, and Ryan the Derby. Then Unzen and Kaimon shall follow...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"An unbroken bloodline. Undying prosperity.
If only such a kingdom could be built."

Together, we talked about our endless dreams,
looking up at the blue sky where airplanes soared.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, thank you so much for today.
Thanks to you, I feel you so very
close...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"*Ahem*, no more keeping secrets from now on, understood?
Please show me all of your secrets, too."
